data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small adverse reestimation of prior year reserves: a deterioration of approximately GBP 1.2m (net) was reported, driven by unfavourable development across a number of classes and an increase in large losses, partly offset by favourable development in the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes. Motor (Motor Warranty) experience also worsened through increased attritional claims. The opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2019 (comparative) was GBP 86.423m. RITC activity in prior periods and limited gross prioryear movement disclosure mean the only explicitly quantified prioryear change available in the report is the net deterioration referenced above.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
the Motor Warranty book within the Consumer Products portfolio experienced an increase in attritional claims activity
the 1861-led Casualty consortium was impacted by an increase in the number of large losses reported
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (2017 & older) is provided in the 'movement in prior year's provision' format. The report explicitly states a NET deterioration of GBP 1.2m to claims reserves established at the prior year end (Note 9) - this NET figure has been used as a fallback for prior_year_development_gbp_m and flagged accordingly. There are RITC adjustments (notably 2016 & Prior) which distort opening/adjusted balances and complicate extraction of a clean gross PYD. A gross claims development table is present but only for the 2017 year of account; no consolidated gross prior-years movement figure is shown. Users should treat the prior_year_development_gbp_m as a net-derived, lowerconfidence estimate.
